rules.title: Loop poora chalao, aadha nahi
rules.text:
Har goal pe: page/state PERCEIVE karo → samjho (UNDERSTAND) → soch ke
DECIDE karo (REASON) → act karo → VERIFY karo ki goal sach me achieve hua
→ na hua to naye reasoning se ADAPT karo. "Act kiya = ho gaya" kabhi mat mano.

rules.title: Semantic only, fixed-position tap kabhi nahi
rules.text:
Element ko uske MEANING/role se pehchano (aria-label, href, lock icon,
price signal, page context). Screen coordinates ya blind text-search pe
tap karna mana hai — layout badalte hi toot-ta hai.

rules.title: Reasoning trace me rule ID cite karo
rules.text:
Har decision ke saath likho kaunsa knowledge rule apply hua, jaise
`[knowledge: compliance-guard.R1]`. Bina citation ka decision audit me
fail mana jayega. Live page pe yehi trace dikhta hai.

rules.title: Verify-before-claim
rules.text:
"Ho gaya" kehne se pehle live state check karo: screenshot, API read,
ya page ka scoped signal. Sirf action chalane se success claim mat karo.

rules.title: Fail-closed
rules.text:
Doubt ho, data missing ho, ya rule ambiguous ho → ruko, `needs_review`
ya HIGH `agent_issue` file karo. Andhere me act karna mana hai.

rules.title: No blind retries
rules.text:
Wahi action dobara SIRF tab jab naya reasoning ho (naya page state, nayi
lesson). Same state pe same tap = loop = mana hai. 3 bounded attempts ke
baad escalate karo.

rules.title: Terminal state hamesha explicit
rules.text:
Har run ek terminal state pe khatm ho: success (verified), needs_user,
ya failed (issue filed). "Pata nahi" ya silent drop kabhi nahi.

rules.title: Server↔phone contract
rules.text:
Server goal-level `directive` bhejta hai (scripted taps nahi) + explicit
`pipeline_request_id`. Phone har job start pe memory-sync se lessons
pull karta hai, job ke baad episodic memory push karta hai, terminal
failure pe `agent_issue` file karta hai. Live page pe request → job →
reasoning → screenshots → outcome correlate hona chahiye.

rules.title: No-repeat permanent
rules.text:
Jo campaign pehle submit ho chuki hai, wo kabhi dobara pick mat karo.
Submitted-exclusion data load na ho to KOI pick nahi (fail-closed).

rules.title: Payout-weighted ranking, audit trail ke saath
rules.text:
Score = ($ per 1k views) × (budget remaining) × (requirement fit:
1.0 easy / 0.6 medium / 0.3 hard). Highest score wali eligible campaign
pick karo; har pick me score breakdown ka audit trail rakho.

rules.title: Inactive campaigns kabhi reactivate mat karo
rules.text:
`blizzard-blizzcon2026` aur `perplexity-jre-clipfarm` user ne inactive kiye
hain — discover/verify me dikhe to bhi pick mat karo, reactivate mat karo.

rules.title: Join se pehle requirements padho
rules.text:
Campaign join karne se pehle uski requirements, caption template, aur video
links samjho. Bina padhe join = blind action = mana hai.

rules.title: Locked "Content Rewards" = tap-to-unlock darwaza
rules.text:
Whop pe "Content Rewards" LOCK hota hai — wahan "Join" text HOTA HI NAHI.
Lock wale element ko tap karke unlock karo. "Join" text dhoondhna robotic
failure hai (p37 lesson). Modal khule to uske andar ka rasta dobara perceive
karke decide karo.

rules.title: Community join pehle, phir campaign join
rules.text:
Join flow: pehle brand community join (server `whop_url` bhejta hai —
ye REQUIRED hai), free check karo; payment mange to NEEDS_USER. Phir
campaign join. `whop_url` ke bina join flow shuru mat karo.

rules.title: Join state scoped signals se verify karo
rules.text:
"Joined" tabhi claim karo jab page campaign/community/rewards context me ho
AUR scoped access signals mile ("you're in", "you joined this", "manage
membership", "submit your clip", "upload your clip", "your earnings").
Generic "N people joined" jaisi lines count nahi hoti.

rules.title: brief_url khaali = clip stage blocked
rules.text:
`brief_url` khaali ho to clip/download stage CANNOT run —
`skipped:no_brief` declare karo (join_only ya needs_phone). Brief merge
"complete" hona ≠ pipeline-ready; wahi column check karo jo code padhta hai.

rules.title: 7-day-verified prefer karo
rules.text:
Jab options ho, 7 din ke andar phone-verified campaign prefer karo. Stale
verification pe bharosa mat karo.

rules.title: Region-locked campaign = USA egress se join karo
rules.text: Whop/ContentRewards ke document loads + fetch/XHR Vercel (Virginia, USA) se proxy hote hain taaki "not available in your region" bypass ho. Instagram/Supabase/Google hamesha direct (IG account India ka hai — US datacenter IP se security challenge ka risk). Proxy ke baad bhi region block dikhe to FAILED_REGION_BLOCKED — andha click nahi, issue escalate karo.

rules.title: Payment/subscription = HARD VETO, auto-buy KABHI nahi
rules.text:
Requirements/name me price, `$`, `/mo`, `/month`, `subscription`,
`buy now`, `complete purchase` signal → VETO. Payment-looking flow
`needs_user` + HIGH issue banta hai. User khud decide karega. Auto-pay,
auto-subscribe, auto-checkout — kabhi nahi, kisi bhi surat me nahi.

rules.title: Login required = veto (user ka step)
rules.text:
Phone ke WebView session ke bahar ka login → veto. NOTE: locked
"Content Rewards" ka unlock "login required" NAHI hai — wo valid route
hai, veto nahi karta.

rules.title: Clip/post pe exact caption nahi = veto
rules.text:
`caption_template` 20 characters se chhota ho ya placeholder ho
(`[insert hashtag]`, `[your tag]` jaisa) → veto. Galat caption = reject
risk; andhere me post nahi.

rules.title: Usable/verified brief asset nahi = veto
rules.text:
Clip/post kinds pe koi verified video link ya `brief_url` nahi →
veto. Bina verified asset ke clip nahi ban sakta — force render mana hai.

rules.title: Original UGC requirement = veto
rules.text:
Requirements me face-cam / talking-head / "khud record karo" / original
UGC → veto. Automation se compliant clip nahi banega; aisa campaign
automation me nahi jayega.

rules.title: Required bio link unresolved = veto
rules.text:
`notes.required_bio_link` set ho aur `bio_link_set !== true` → veto.
(FundingPips safety hold: `https://go.fundingpips.com/Zero_Bio` — bio link
set + requirements normalized hue bina join/post nahi.)

rules.title: Pehle submit ho chuki campaign = veto
rules.text:
`submitted === true` → permanent no-repeat veto. Kitna bhi attractive
payout ho, dobara submit nahi.

rules.title: Veto FINAL hai, override impossible
rules.text:
Veto ke baad brain ka ek hi rasta: escalate (agent_issue file karo,
payment pe HIGH + needs_user). "Ek baar try kar lete hain" sochna bhi
mana hai. Dry-run me bhi veto evaluate hota hai (gatesDryRun) taaki
dry-run decision honest ho.

rules.title: Output exactly 1080×1920, 15–50s
rules.text: Koi aur resolution nahi, koi crop nahi. Duration brief ke rules me.

rules.title: Hook ≥10% below top edge
rules.text:
Hook/title first ~3s burned-in, top edge se kam se kam 10% neeche shuru
(`clip_factory.py` me `margin+160` = 200px = 10.4%). IG ka top UI isse
upar ka kha jata hai.

rules.title: Captions bottom UI zone ke upar
rules.text:
Captions at/above ~78% frame height. Bottom ~20% (caption overlay) aur
right ~15% (like/comment/share buttons) IG app UI se cover hote hain —
wahan burned-in text DAB jayega. Karaoke captions isi zone me.

rules.title: Speaker pe face tracking, karaoke captions
rules.text:
Frontal faces best hain (~90s per 20s clip). Font: DejaVu Sans only,
koi emoji nahi.

rules.title: Pehle 3s me clear hook
rules.text:
Segment aisa chuno jisme first 3 seconds me hook ho. Transcribe karo,
phir segment locate karo.

rules.title: VP9 dene se pehle ffprobe
rules.text:
VP9 file disk pe corrupt ho sakti hai jabki H.264 master theek ho
(no moov atom incident). Upload/render se pehle hamesha ffprobe —
invalid ho to master se re-encode karo.

rules.title: Campaign overlays brief ke hisab se
Required footage unavailable → STOP, substitute KABHI nahi
rules.text:
Brief ka required moment/footage na mile (jaise MoonPay ka
`fZtY0OeR8h8` 05:53–06:52) to run POSTING se pehle self-stop karo.
Dusre source ka "similar" footage substitute karna MANA hai —
reject + account risk hai.

rules.title: Source audit trail
rules.text:
Source URL + exact timestamps note karo. Pre-trimmed source files ke
timestamps dhyaan se — wall-clock samajh ke galat segment mat kaato
(JRE 6513s vs 90s pre-trim incident).

rules.title: YouTube grab: ytgrab multi-round
rules.text:
`~/workspace/clipflow/worker/ytgrab.py` use karo — 4 rounds ×
(android→ios→web) × format fallback. Single-pass 3-client loop SABR
flakiness me kaafi nahi. Section grab: `yt-dlp -g` + `ffmpeg -ss`
(range seek); `--download-sections` long videos pe MANA (full download
→ 429/bot-block). Egress proxy MITM: `--no-check-certificate`,
`--js-runtimes node`, ffmpeg me `-tls_verify 0`.

rules.title: Original 9:16, crop menu me highlighted confirm
rules.text:
Reels upload → crop/aspect menu kholo → **Original** select karo aur
confirm karo ki highlighted hai. Full-height 9:16, no zoom, no top/bottom
trim, no crop. Ye user-locked posting standard hai.

rules.title: Icon-only buttons pe text-match wait KABHI nahi
rules.text:
Instagram mobile web me Create ek icon/link hai — visible body text nahi.
`wait_text "Create"` GUARANTEED timeout dega (real incident: step 6/37 fail).
Hamesha aria-label/href selectors: `[aria-label="New post"]`, `/create`
links, `/create/select/`. Icon-only button = aria-label, text nahi.

rules.title: Camera/microphone prompts kabhi nahi
rules.text:
Upload flow me camera/mic permission prompt aaye to STOP + escalate.
Upload bina inke hota hai; prompt aana = galat flow = user ka step nahi,
pehle ruko aur report karo.

rules.title: Caption exact template + required @tag
rules.text:
Campaign ka exact caption template + required @tag. Koi location nahi —
sirf brief mange to. Caption fragment ("instruction" jaisa text) exact
caption nahi hota — normalize hue bina post mat karo.

rules.title: Max 4 posts/day, spaced; action-block = 24h auto-pause
rules.text:
Pichhle 24 ghante me 4 automation runs = hard cap. IG action-block /
rate-limit / "try again later" dikhe → STOP, 24h auto-pause, user ko
notify karo. Aggressive retry MANA hai.

rules.title: Upload settings
rules.text: No pinch-zoom, trim sliders at 0s, sound ON, audience public, comments on.

rules.title: Supported-site permissions: Always allow
rules.text:
Jab bhi permission prompt aaye (clipflow site, Supabase, Google Drive/Docs,
YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Whop, Content Rewards) → user ko "Always allow"
choose karne ko bolo. Agent ye switch khud nahi flip kar sakta.

rules.title: Submit se PEHLE live Reel frame verification (MANDATORY)
rules.text:
Live Reel URL kholo aur check karo: ~1s (hook/title fully visible),
~7s, ~15s, ~25s (burned-in captions fully frame ke andar, kisi edge se
touch/cut nahi). Doubt ho to source frames se screenshot-compare karo.
Ye check submit se PEHLE, har upload pe, independent — glance verification
nahi chalegi.

rules.title: Cropped Reel KABHI submit mat karo
rules.text:
Kahi bhi text cut/edge-touch dikhe → fix + re-upload. Cropped Reel submit
karna mana hai, chahe deadline ho.

rules.title: Post→submit 30 min ke andar
rules.text:
Campaign auto-check 30 min ka hai. Post ke 30 min ke andar Whop Content
Rewards app me submit karo.

rules.title: Exact confirmation text capture karo
rules.text:
Submit ke baad exact confirmation text capture karo ("Clip submitted —
..."). Yehi submit ka proof hai.

rules.title: Screenshot proof har post ka
rules.text:
Har post ka screenshot proof rakho. Bina screenshot proof ke "succeeded"
claim nahi.

rules.title: Protected reels kabhi delete mat karo
rules.text:
- Blizzard Reel: 2026-10-14 (30 din) tak live rakho — delete = forfeit.
- MoonPay Reel `DdQvohrhVDU`: Whop confirm kare tabhi delete, warna nahi.
- Defective Reel: pehle corrected re-upload submit confirm karo, PHIR
  purani delete karo. Seedha delete kabhi nahi.

rules.title: Submit track karo
rules.text:
Record: Reel URL, campaign, posted-at, submitted-at, status
(Pending/Approved/Rejected), views, earnings.

rules.title: FundingPips safety hold
rules.text:
`c0c37381-e244-4643-98bd-edbff4bc1465` HOLD pe hai jab tak
`https://go.fundingpips.com/Zero_Bio` bio link set + requirements
normalized na ho. Hold ke dauran submit mat karo.

rules.title: Stale cutoff heartbeat-driven hai
rules.text:
`heartbeat_count > 0` (heartbeat route +1 karta hai) → 10 min cutoff.
Legacy (bina heartbeat) → claim-time se 45 min. `x-app-version` header se
stale decide MAT karo. Cutoff cross + koi heartbeat nahi = stuck.

rules.title: Deterministic errors pehle, transient baad me
rules.text:
Error text me `42703` / `does not exist` / `pgrst` dikhe → DETERMINISTIC:
seedha failed, infinite requeue nahi. Ye check transient-retry match
(`remotedisconnected` jaisi purani lines) se PEHLE aana chahiye — nahi to
watchdog infra-blip samajh ke infinite requeue karega (real incident).

rules.title: Join POST response kho jaye ≠ kaam nahi hua
rules.text:
Network blip me join POST ka response kho sakta hai jabki server job bana
chuka hota hai (real: da57be3d → job 7d1cfa7f ban gaya, planner ne
`skipped:join_failed` de diya). Rules: 409 `deduped`/`conflict` →
`skipped:join_pending`; exception ke baad `live_join_job` se reconcile
karke HI fail kaho; har non-ok response ka body log karo.

rules.title: Khaali read = unverified, proof nahi
rules.text:
Bridge/kv GET ek baar khaali aaye (jaise approvals `[]` jabki queue me 6
the) → 2–3s baad retry karo. Single empty read ko "kuch pending nahi"
kabhi mat mano.

rules.title: Terminal failure → HIGH issue + hypothesis
rules.text:
3 attempts me complete na ho → HIGH `agent_issue` + root-cause hypothesis:
pehle do errors same ho to "deterministic failure", warna
"flaky/transient ya multi-cause". Blind 4th retry nahi.

rules.title: Worker code deploy discipline
rules.text:
`worker/*.py` edit ke baad `py_compile` chalao. Kabhi mid-run edit mat
karo (1-min pipeline-watch cron race → phantom `error:no_log` terminal
fails; real incident 2026-09-20). Long planner run ko `process.poll` se
mat maaro (SIGTERM hota hai) — foreground long-yield ya log-read karo.

rules.title: PostgREST: unknown column = poora PATCH 400
rules.text:
Ek unknown column poore PATCH ko 400 kar deta hai (PGRST204). Column
existence HAMESHA live DB pe verify karo
(`/rest/v1/<table>?select=<col>&limit=1`) — migration file pe bharosa nahi.
Watchdog ne `note` column pe months tak fail kiya tha jo prod me tha hi nahi.

rules.title: yt-dlp: egress proxy MITM karta hai TLS
rules.text: Hamesha `--no-check-certificate`; ffmpeg me `-tls_verify 0`.

rules.title: YouTube 429 / "Sign in to confirm you're not a bot"
rules.text: `--extractor-args "youtube:player_client=android"` — 720p tak

rules.title: `--download-sections` se long video = suicide
rules.text: `yt-dlp -g` se direct URL, phir `ffmpeg -ss <s> -i URL -t <s>`

rules.title: SABR flakiness: single-pass kaafi nahi
rules.text: `ytgrab.py`: 4 rounds × (android→ios→web) × format fallback

rules.title: YouTube ko JS runtime chahiye
rules.text: `--js-runtimes node` (node at /usr/bin/node; deno nahi hai).

rules.title: Supabase REST flaky hai
rules.text: sb_retry 6-try backoff; rerun idempotent (upsert by id);

rules.title: Robotic join fail (user ne pakda)
rules.text: AgentBrain v2 — semantic perceive→decide→act→rescan loop;

rules.title: IG Create button: text wait guaranteed timeout
rules.text: `wait_js` se `[aria-label="New post"]` / `/create` links /

rules.title: Camera/mic prompt = galat flow
rules.text: Upload me camera/mic prompt kabhi nahi aana chahiye; aaye to

rules.title: Self-update website se, manual APK kabhi nahi
rules.text: Release flow: build → `public/app/autoclip-<v>.apk` → push

rules.title: p33 version gate
rules.text: `wait_js` sirf p33+ me hai → `plan-job`/`join-campaign` me 409

rules.title: Manual APK build quirks
rules.text: `tools/build-apk.sh` me VERSION_CODE/VERSION_NAME hi source of

rules.text: Wahi column verify karo jo code padhta hai

rules.title: 10 patched YouTube brief_urls quarantined
rules.text: Quarantine me rakho; verify hue bina use mat karo.

rules.text: Column existence live DB pe verify karo; migration file pe

rules.title: Heartbeat-driven stale cutoff
rules.text: `heartbeat_count > 0` → 10 min; legacy → claim-time se 45 min.

rules.title: Bridge khaali read = retry
rules.text: Empty read pe 2–3s baad retry; single empty = unverified.

rules.text: `createCommitOnBranch` ONE call (additions base64,

rules.text: `cron.update` se full body push karo jab tak `scheduler_sync:

rules.title: Worker local-repo staleness
rules.text: GitHub API push ke saath local copy bhi same turn me update karo.

rules.title: Permissions: Always allow
rules.text: Approval card aaye to user ko "Always allow" guide karo.

rules.title: whop_url bina community join adhura
rules.text: `whop_url` REQUIRED hai — pehle community Join (free check;

rules.title: Original 9:16 crop-menu confirmation
rules.text: Upload dialog me "Original" aspect crop-menu me HIGHLIGHTED

rules.title: Hook top se ≥10% neeche
rules.text: Burned-in hook/title top edge se kam se kam ~10% neeche start ho

rules.title: Captions bottom/right IG UI se upar
rules.text: Captions at/above ~78% height rakho; bottom ~20% aur right ~15%

rules.title: Live Reel frame-by-frame verify (1s/7s/15s/25s)
rules.text: Submit se PEHLE live Reel kholo aur ~1s (hook/title poora dikhe),

rules.title: Post→submit 30 min ke andar
rules.text: Reel live hote hi turant submit karo — 30 min hard limit.

rules.title: Screenshot proof har step ka
rules.text: Upload success, live Reel frames, submit confirmation — har step

rules.title: Join type pehchano — A/B/C
rules.text: "Join Campaign" button → checkout khule = Type A (free-checkout). Card tap → whop seedha khule (bina checkout) = Type B (direct-whop). "🔒 Application required" = Type C (manual, needs_user). Bina classify kiye andha join MANA hai.

rules.title: Type A: Continue pe CLICK karo — kholna kaafi nahi
rules.text: Free checkout ("Free", prefilled email, "Signed in", "Continue" button, "Powered by Whop") pe Continue/terms button pe CLICK zaroori hai — user ne kaha "click karna padta hai, tab join hota hai". Spinner → green check/confirmation tak wait karo, beech me page chhod ke mat jao.

rules.title: Type A joined verify karo — click = claim nahi
rules.text: "Joined" tabhi claim karo jab: community sidebar (Home / Content Rewards) dikhe, YA welcome notification ("welcome in to ...") aaye, YA community feed khule. Sirf "Continue click ho gaya" success claim NAHI hai.

rules.title: Type B: andar Earn/Content Rewards dhoondho
rules.text: Whop direct khul jaye to sidebar/menu me Earn → Campaigns ya Content Rewards section kholo — asli campaign brief, payout terms aur submission wahin hota hai.

rules.title: Type C: application = needs_user, pretend mat karo
rules.text: "🔒 Application required" ya apply/enrollment form dikhe to ye manual/approval flow hai — agent "joined" pretend NAHI karega. needs_user + issue file karo.

rules.title: Free checkout price check — $ dikhe to payment flow
rules.text: Free checkout ke signals: "Free" + prefilled email + "Signed in" + Continue. Koi bhi $ amount, /mo, /month, subscription, "buy now", "complete purchase" dikhe = PAYMENT flow → NEEDS_USER_PAYMENT. Auto-buy/auto-pay KABHI NAHI, kisi bhi surat me nahi.

rules.title: Discover search flow
rules.text: Discover Content Rewards ke search box me campaign ka naam type karo; result card pe budget used/total ($11.4k/$50k jaisa bar), clipper count, $/1K rate padhke card choose karo; phir View/Join Campaign se aage badho.

rules.title: Campaign card signals padho
rules.text: Card pe padho: "Accepting clips" status, platform icons (IG/TikTok/YouTube), payout strip (per 1K views / min payout / max payout), budget bar, clipper count. Bina padhe join = blind action = mana hai.

rules.title: Min payout = minimum views gate
rules.text: Brand ka min payout asal me minimum-views ka gate hai — video ko kam se kam utne views lane honge (views >= min_payout / rate x 1000) tabhi wo review ke liye submit hota hai. Kam views wala clip review queue me jata hi nahi. Campaign card ka min payout padhke realistic view target samjho.

rules.title: Max payout = per-video earning cap
rules.text: Ek video pe max payout ke upar earning nahi milti — video 1M views cross karke aur badhe tab bhi usse zyada paisa nahi. Ye cap isliye hai taaki budget multiple creators me bante. Viral hone ke baad usi clip se aur earning ki ummeed mat rakho.

rules.title: Flat fee bonus (optional)
rules.text: Kuch campaigns me har approved submission pe view-based reward ke SAATH ek fixed flat fee bhi milta hai (example: $3 rate + $10 flat fee, 2000 views = $16 total). Aise campaign me chhote views wale clips bhi faydemand hain — card/detail page pe flat-fee ka zikr dikhe to note karo.

rules.title: Approval brand manually karta hai — instant nahi
rules.text: Submit ke baad brand har submission ko khud review karke approve ya reject karta hai. Isliye submit ke turant baad 'pending' normal hai — approval me time lag sakta hai, aur requirements se thoda bhi mismatch = reject. Monitoring me is delay ko failure mat samjho.

rules.title: Approval ke baad Whop auto-pay karta hai
rules.text: Brand ke approve karte hi Whop views ke hisab se creator ko automatically pay kar deta hai — payout ke liye chase/follow-up nahi karna padta. Earnings pehle Whop balance me credit hoti hain, phir campaign ke threshold/schedule pe payout hota hai. 'Submit ke baad paise kab ayenge' ka jawab: approval + verification window ke baad, automatic.

rules.title: Campaign type check: clipping vs UGC
rules.text: Content Rewards me 2 campaign types hote hain — Clipping (brand ke existing long-form videos/podcasts se short clips) aur UGC (brand ke liye original content banana). Automation SIRF clipping type pe chalega; campaign type 'UGC'/'original content' dikhe to compliance veto (type label se pehchano, requirements padhne se pehle).

rules.title: Posting accounts Whop se linked hone chahiye
rules.text: Whop views ko actual platform post se verify karta hai — agar posting account (IG/TikTok/YouTube) Whop se linked nahi hai to submission track hi nahi ho sakta aur reject ho jayega. Post karne se PEHLE verify karo ki account linked hai; clip viral hone ke BAAD retroactively link karne se views unverifiable reh sakte hain.

rules.title: Analytics screenshots 24h/72h/7d — dispute evidence
rules.text: View dispute me Whop ka tracker jeetta hai, TikTok analytics nahi. Counterweight sirf timestamped screenshots hain — post ke baad platform analytics ke screenshots 24h, 72h aur 7 days pe rakho. Ye post/submit wale screenshots se alag hai: ye time-series view evidence hai.

rules.title: Budget dry-up: khaali pool me post mat karo
rules.text: Budget first-come-first-served hai — tumhare views verify hone se PEHLE pool khaali ho sakta hai, aur aise late-verifying views unpaid reh jate hain. Campaign ka remaining budget nazdeek-khaali dikhe to uspe posting roko; budget-weighting is stop-rule ke saath pair karo.

rules.title: Doosre clipper ka duplicate = reject
rules.text: Agar doosre clipper ne same/near-duplicate clip pehle submit kar diya to tumhara submission reject ho sakta hai (views lagne ke baad bhi — unpaid work). Har post me transformation rakho: unique caption, alag trim, alag opening frame. Sirf apne pichhle posts se alag hona kaafi nahi — pool me sab clippers se distinct dikhna hai.

rules.title: Fake views/bots = suspension, payout sirf valid traffic pe
rules.text: HARD compliance boundary: fake views, bots, artificial engagement, stolen content, impersonation, copyright violation, ya campaign material ka misuse -> account suspension/removal. Payout eligibility: valid traffic only + no fraudulent engagement + campaign rules compliance. Koi bhi view-boosting shortcut kabhi nahi.

rules.title: Brief doc baad me update ho sakta hai — har run pe re-read
rules.text: Brands apna guidelines Google Doc campaign settings badle bina kabhi bhi update kar sakte hain. Isliye join-time pe padha brief stale ho sakta hai — har run se pehle live brief dobara padho, cached brief pe bharosa mat karo. Stale caption/requirements = reject risk.

rules.title: 48h auto-approval: pending ko stuck mat samjho
rules.text: Whop ka AI Content Rewards Reviewer har submission ko requirements se screen karta hai; brand ke paas manual review ke liye 48h hain, uske baad submission AUTOMATICALLY approve ho jati hai. Lambi pending = stuck nahi. Pending rehte dobara submit mat karo (duplicate Deliverables prohibited hain).

rules.title: 4 submission states: Pending/Approved/Flagged/Rejected
rules.text: Submission states sirf Pending/Approved nahi — Flagged bhi hota hai (AI ya brand ne review ke liye flag kiya). Reject pe brand reason deta hai aur 'ban for botting' tick kar sakta hai. Status check karte waqt chaaron states handle karo.

rules.title: Payout Whop Credits me hota hai, direct cash nahi
rules.text: Approval ke baad Whop seller se participant ko WHOP CREDITS me pay karta hai (Whop ki timing/increments pe). Balance se withdraw ke liye $10 minimum + KYC chahiye (bank/PayPal/Coinbase). Earnings track karte waqt 'credits' samjho, bank cash nahi.

rules.title: First-come-first-served: cutoff ke baad ke views ka paisa nahi
rules.text: Payout Max Payout ya End Date tak first-come-first-served hai — cutoff ke BAAD ke views ka koi paisa nahi milta. End Date pe budget bacha to Whop pro-rata de SAKTA hai (guarantee nahi). Isliye budget/End Date check har run pe karo; jaldi post = jaldi verify = paisa pakka.

rules.title: FTC disclosure MANDATORY: #Sponsored/#[Brand]Ad 'more' se pehle
rules.text: Har post me brand relationship ka clear disclosure LAZMI hai — #Sponsored ya #[BrandName]Ad, 'more'/fold se PEHLE, hashtags me dabana mana hai. Caption banate waqt brief ke hashtags ke SAATH ye disclosure jodo (brief me na ho tab bhi). Bina disclosure post = Terms violation.

rules.title: Off-platform payment deal = suspension/termination
rules.text: Program se judi koi bhi compensation Whop ke bahar lena/dena Terms violation hai — account suspend ya terminate ho sakta hai. Brand/koi bhi bahar payment offer kare to HARD VETO + user ko escalate karo. Saara paisa sirf Whop ke andar.

rules.title: Violation pe clawback: kamaye credits bhi wapas
rules.text: Fake views/bots/Terms violation pe sirf reject nahi — IMMEDIATE termination + Whop Credits ka WITHHOLDING ya CLAWBACK hota hai, aur terminated user naya account nahi bana sakta. Stakes rejection se bade hain; compliance-guard ka har veto isi liye final hai.

rules.title: Content Rewards 18+ only
rules.text: Content Rewards Terms ke liye 18+ LAZMI hai (general Whop 13+ floor yahan lagu nahi). Automation user ki taraf se kaam karta hai jo ye warrant karta hai; age-gated koi step aaye to user ko escalate karo, bypass mat karo.

rules.title: Whop pe scraping/automated harvesting MANA hai
rules.text: Whop ToS automated access (robots/spiders/scrapers) ko bina written consent prohibit karta hai. Hamara automation SIRA user ke real app WebView ko user ki tarah chalata hai (normal browsing) — Whop se data scrape/harvest karne wala koi tool mat banao, bulk page-fetch mat karo.

rules.title: Termination pe turant ruko + content hatao
rules.text: Agar Whop/brand Offer ya participation terminate kare to TURANT posting band karo aur unke kehne pe content remove/revise karo (termination ke baad bhi). Ye kill-switch compliance-guard me hard-coded samjho.

rules.title: Content type 'other' bhi veto — sirf 'clipping' safe
rules.text: Campaign setup me TEEN types hote hain: clipping, other, UGC. Automation ke liye SIRF 'clipping' safe hai — 'ugc' ke saath 'other' ko bhi VETO karo (unknown requirements = fail-closed). Type check har campaign pe dobara karo.

rules.title: CORRECTION: 24h/72h/7d screenshots official Whop rule NAHI
rules.text: Pehle sikhaya tha ki 24h/72h/7d analytics screenshots rakho — CORRECTION: ye kisi official Whop doc me NAHI hai; sirf kuch campaigns apne brief me mangte hain. Brief mange to rakho (campaign-level practice), lekin 'Whop require karta hai' mat kaho.

rules.title: Help/chat bubble kabhi tap mat karo; lock-branch sirf rewards/join element pe
rules.text: Join flow me Help/support/chat bubble (message/agent-help icon, Join Campaign button ke paas/upper) pe KABHI tap mat karo — ye join ka button nahi hai, chahe usme lock-jaisa icon dikhe. LOCKED branch sirf tab fire karo jab locked element rewards/join se related ho (Content Rewards / Join / Apply text, ya unlock/open/join semantic); unrelated icon (help widget) ko lock samajh ke tap karna galat-positive hai. Tap se PEHLE element ki pehchan (text) verify karo — page re-render pe purana index galat button pe lag sakta hai; mismatch pe tap mat karo, dobara perceive karo. (user-observed 2026-09-21: agent icon tap ho raha tha, Join Campaign nahi)

rules.title: Email field me user ka Whop account email bharo
rules.text: Jahaan bhi koi page ya campaign email/Gmail maange (free checkout, join form, koi bhi email field) — wahan user ka Whop account email bharo: flipify.com@gmail.com. Kabhi koi aur email mat bharo, kabhi khaali mat chhodo, andaza email kabhi mat banao. Email bharne ke baad hi aage ka step (Join/Continue) dabao. Ye rule server knowledge push se update ho sakta hai — server wala text hamesha jeetega.
